titlePlain: Values Files Per Environment: the Same Pattern as
subtitle: Lesson 23 · Deploying with Helm

code:
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: registry.example.com/myapp
  tag: "2.1.4"
resources:
  requests: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }
  limits:   { cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi }
ingress:
  enabled: false
caption: The base file — what applies when nothing overrides it.

code:
replicaCount: 6
resources:
  requests: { cpu: 500m, memory: 512Mi }
  limits:   { cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi }
ingress:
  enabled: true
  host: myapp.example.com

# helm upgrade --install myapp ./myapp \
#   --values values.yaml --values values-prod.yaml \
#   --namespace prod
caption: Later --values files win on conflicting keys; everything else falls back.

steps.label: terraform apply -var-file="prod.tfvars"  →  helm upgrade --values values-prod.yaml
steps.sub: one definition, environment-specific values layered on

steps.label: terraform workspace select prod  →  release name + --namespace prod
steps.sub: Helm has no workspace; this pairing isolates installs instead

steps.label: Terraform state file  →  release state in the cluster
steps.sub: tracked per release name/namespace, not in a separate state file

subtitle: helm upgrade, helm rollback, and reading release history.
